title: Catalog Management
content_data:
If you have a large volume of rapidly changing products, it is recommended to use the Catalog API to manage them. With this, advertisers can create, update, and delete multiple products in a single HTTP request. > **Important**
By using Catalog API endpoints, you agree to the [Product Catalog Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/article?aid=6765817026859499525) and certify that you are abiding by the [TikTok Advertising Policies](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=6685586866860720134). Please review these policies and ensure that the items you upload to your catalog don't breach them. - To learn about the concepts and benefits of catalogs, see [Overview](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263078057986). - To find out how to create and manage catalogs as well as some catalog related use cases, see [Guides](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263100123137). - [Mapping between Catalog Management features in Catalog Manager and API configurations](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1782141580104705): Outlines the mapping between the Catalog Management features in Catalog Manager and the corresponding API configurations. - [Create catalogs and add products](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263112945665): Introduces how to create catalogs and add products, including creating a catalog, uploading products, updating products, creating a product set, and binding event source to a catalog. - [Troubleshoot catalogs with diagnostics](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1780803490136066): Introduces how to troubleshoot catalog products and event sources, including the Catalog Match Rate, by using Catalog Diagnostics. - [Mapping between Catalog Diagnostics features in Catalog Manager and API configurations](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1780803525320706): Outlines the mapping between the features for diagnosing catalog products and catalog event sources in Catalog Manager and the corresponding API configurations. - [Obtain Catalog Product Insights](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1805642743426050): Introduces how to obtain trending catalog products within your catalog and trending catalog product categories on TikTok. - [Mapping between Catalog Product Insights features in Catalog Manager and API configurations](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1805642902406145): Outlines the mapping between the Catalog Product Insights features in Catalog Manager and the corresponding API configurations. - [Upload catalog videos to associate with catalog products](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1803654904260674): Introduces how to upload and manage catalog videos in your catalog. - [Manage catalogs in a Business Center](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738964064361474): Introduces how to manage catalogs as Business Center assets, including migrating catalogs to a Business Center and managing catalogs after migration. - [Use catalogs when creating Shopping Ads](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263154550786): Introduces how to use catalogs to create Shopping Ads. - To find out what APIs are available for managing catalogs, see [API reference](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739578477445121).
